disclaimer: Fixture replay and static checks are not a live WeChat path. 开发版或体验版二维码不能证明“任何人扫码即可使用”。只有正式审核通过后的正式版小程序码，经未加入开发者或体验成员名单的微信账号完成闭环，才能声称公众可用。

evidence_classes.FIXTURE_VERIFIED: Automated replay of recorded API v0 fixtures passed. Not a deployed system.
evidence_classes.STATIC_CHECK: Files, docs, or scanners were inspected. No live system was exercised.
evidence_classes.NOT_VERIFIED: No evidence has been produced yet.
evidence_classes.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: Cannot be verified until AppID, domain, legal entity, or WeChat review is available.

items.criteria: catalog.json lists every required scenario and all files parse.
items.expected_evidence: Vitest PASS; 14 required scenarios loaded.

items.criteria: POST /api/v1/reviews → 202 queued; GET → succeeded; finding PATCH succeeds; every JSON body has request_id.
items.expected_evidence: HTTP replay matches recorded 200/202 envelopes.

items.criteria: GET status=degraded uses the frozen degradation_notice. Must not present as 没有问题.
items.expected_evidence: Caution string exact match.

items.criteria: GET status=failed includes a frozen error code and does not claim 没有问题.
items.expected_evidence: Failed envelope with UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.

items.criteria: Missing or invalid bearer returns 401 AUTH_REQUIRED.
items.expected_evidence: 401 envelopes for create/get/delete/invalid token.

items.criteria: Owner B cannot GET/PATCH/DELETE owner A's review_id. Authenticated non-owners receive 404 REVIEW_NOT_FOUND.
items.expected_evidence: 404 REVIEW_NOT_FOUND for B; 200 for A.

items.criteria: Same Idempotency-Key and body reuse the same review_id. Declared quota/model deduction is 1, not a deployed meter.
items.expected_evidence: Two 202 responses share review_id.

items.criteria: Same Idempotency-Key with a different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
items.expected_evidence: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

items.criteria: Missing privacy version, client-supplied user_id, and wrong types return 400 INVALID_REQUEST. Stale privacy version returns 400 PRIVACY_NOTICE_OUTDATED.
items.expected_evidence: 400 envelopes.

items.criteria: Title > 200 or body > 10000 UTF-16 code units returns 413 ARTICLE_TOO_LARGE.
items.expected_evidence: 413 envelopes using Public API v0 limits 200/10000.

items.criteria: Content-safety rejection returns 422 CONTENT_REJECTED.
items.expected_evidence: 422 envelope using a synthetic marker, not real prohibited content.

items.criteria: Over daily_limit returns 429 DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.
items.expected_evidence: 429 envelope. Not a live quota store.

items.criteria: Burst traffic returns 429 RATE_LIMITED.
items.expected_evidence: 429 envelope. Not a live rate limiter.

items.criteria: Owner DELETE → 204; subsequent GET → 404 REVIEW_NOT_FOUND; repeat DELETE → 204.
items.expected_evidence: Recorded 204/404/204 sequence. Does not prove a deleter is deployed.

items.criteria: 503 REVIEW_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED and UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE are stable and leak-free.
items.expected_evidence: Two 503 envelopes.

items.criteria: queued, running, succeeded, degraded, failed, cancelled, expired are all represented.
items.expected_evidence: status-examples.json covers the frozen enum.

items.criteria: Each frozen code maps to its HTTP status and has a leak-free example.
items.expected_evidence: error-examples.json matches api-v0.json.

items.criteria: Fixtures declare 24h retention via expires_at. This is a declaration, not a deployed cleaner.
items.expected_evidence: Declared 24h. deployment_status remains NOT_VERIFIED.

items.criteria: A scheduled cleaner deletes reviews, findings, actions, jobs and excerpt caches after 24h, with monitoring.
items.verification: Not runnable in this worktree. Requires Backend PostgreSQL + worker in integration.
items.expected_evidence: Job logs, deleted-row counts, alert on failure.
blockers: TTL job not integrated or deployed

items.criteria: Production DELETE removes article/findings/actions/job payload and excerpt caches; audit keeps only event metadata.
items.expected_evidence: DB before/after, audit row without manuscript text.
blockers: Delete path not integrated or deployed

items.criteria: Runtime logs contain only allowed IDs/status/usage fields; no bearer, OpenID, or manuscript.
items.verification: Not runnable in this worktree. Sample format is scanned separately.
items.expected_evidence: Staging/production log export with redaction proof.
blockers: Production logger not integrated or deployed

items.criteria: Scanner finds no PEM, cloud keys, or live provider secrets. Test canaries in existing tests/api remain allowed.
items.expected_evidence: PUBLIC_RELEASE_SCAN: PASS

items.criteria: tests/fixtures/public-api/logs/safe-sample.jsonl has no bearer token, OpenID, or full manuscript.
items.expected_evidence: Log sample scan PASS. Format fixture only.

items.item: 错误输出不泄漏内部信息
items.criteria: Error envelopes have no stack, SQL, upstream payload, or provider credentials.
items.expected_evidence: Error payload scan PASS.

items.item: 禁止把 fixture 写成微信通过
items.criteria: No fixture-lane item may be labeled as WeChat review pass or public QR pass.
items.expected_evidence: Matrix statuses stay in the allowed vocabulary; official items remain NOT_VERIFIED/BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.

items.criteria: npm run typecheck passes on the integrated tree.
items.expected_evidence: tsc --noEmit exit 0 on integration/public-v1 after backend and miniprogram merge.
blockers: Integration lane has not absorbed backend/miniprogram

items.criteria: npm run lint passes.
items.expected_evidence: eslint exit 0.

items.criteria: npm test passes, including these public-release tests.
items.expected_evidence: Vitest run exit 0 on the integrated tree.

items.criteria: Existing Web Demo still builds.
items.expected_evidence: Next.js production build exit 0.
blockers: Not re-run in this lane after fixture work

items.criteria: apps/miniprogram builds in WeChat DevTools or CI equivalent.
items.verification: Miniprogram build command owned by Mini Program / Integration writers.
items.expected_evidence: WeChat DevTools or CI build log from the miniprogram feature worktree after integration.
blockers: Miniprogram client exists in its feature worktree but is not integrated here

items.criteria: Staging-like processes accept a fixture article, poll to terminal status, and delete.
items.verification: Integration smoke against loopback, never WeChat production.
items.expected_evidence: Request IDs, job rows, delete 204.
blockers: Public API fixture slice exists in backend worktree but is not integrated or deployed

items.item: 指向集成 API 的黑盒回放
items.criteria: Same fixtures replay against PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL in the integration lane only.
items.verification: Integration-owned env. This lane refuses PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL.
items.expected_evidence: Black-box PASS against staging, still not a WeChat proof.

items.criteria: Documented rollback is executed once in staging.
items.expected_evidence: Rollback log with timestamps.

lanes.title: 微信开发版 / 体验版 Gate

items.criteria: A developer-list account can open the 开发版. This does not prove public access.
items.expected_evidence: Screenshot of 开发版. Must be labeled NOT public.

items.criteria: An experience-member account can open the 体验版. This does not prove public access.
items.expected_evidence: Screenshot of 体验版. Must be labeled NOT public.

items.criteria: Real jscode2session issues an opaque session. OpenID never returns to the client.
items.verification: Staging with real AppID, still not production publish.
items.expected_evidence: Server logs with hashed subject, no OpenID in client payload.
blockers: Real WeChat calls forbidden in this lane

items.item: 服务器域名与业务域名
items.criteria: HTTPS API domain is allowlisted. Turning off domain verification is not evidence.
items.expected_evidence: Domain list screenshot and curl --noproxy TLS 200.

items.item: 开发版/体验版不得当作公开发布
items.criteria: Release notes must state that 开发版 or 体验版 QR codes cannot prove 任何人扫码即可使用.
items.expected_evidence: This document contains the disclaimer. Item remains a process control.

lanes.title: 正式审核和正式二维码 Gate

items.criteria: Legal entity name, type, and WeChat verification match the submitted miniprogram.
items.verification: WeChat admin + business license. Do not fabricate.
items.expected_evidence: Admin screenshot of verified entity. Currently TBD.

items.criteria: Miniprogram filing is complete for the operating entity.
items.expected_evidence: Filing number. Currently TBD.

items.criteria: Release uses the production AppID, not a test/demo id and not a fixture token.
items.verification: WeChat admin AppID compared to production config.
items.expected_evidence: AppID recorded by operator, never committed as a secret companion AppSecret.

items.criteria: Public API is served on a filed HTTPS domain reachable in mainland China.
items.verification: TLS certificate, ICP, WeChat domain list.
items.expected_evidence: Domain + certificate expiry + ICP number.

items.criteria: WeChat privacy guide and in-app notice match actual data flow: wx.login only, 24h retention, no phone number.
items.verification: WeChat privacy-guide UI + product copy review.
items.expected_evidence: Submitted guide text and screenshot.

items.item: 生成式 AI / 平台合规
items.criteria: Generative-AI filing, algorithm filing, security assessment and news-license boundary are confirmed by the operating entity. This repo is not legal advice.
items.verification: Operator-supplied certificates. Do not invent filing numbers.
items.expected_evidence: Filing IDs or a written out-of-scope conclusion.
blockers: 生成式 AI 或相关平台合规要求 TBD

items.criteria: WeChat review status is 审核通过 for the production release.
items.verification: WeChat admin review history. This lane must not submit.
items.expected_evidence: Review-pass screenshot and timestamp.
blockers: 微信审核 not submitted and not authorized

items.item: 正式版二维码陌生账号测试
items.criteria: A WeChat account that is not a developer or experience member scans the official miniprogram code and completes one review within quota.
items.verification: Manual test after WeChat publish. 开发版/体验版 QR is insufficient.
items.expected_evidence: Video or screenshot from the stranger account on the official QR.
blockers: 正式发布 has not happened
